# SoC Integration on FPGA

## Concepts

Board interfaces, clock and reset requirements, memories, and hardware bring-up.

## Implementation

Adapt a RISC-V SoC to a selected FPGA board and document target-specific requirements.

## Hands-on Experiments

Load the design, run a small software workload, and compare hardware results with simulation.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
